t: While in the astral body, defeat Life Incarnate in the Heart of Life and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

Life is the most precious thing to a rational being. Taking life is easy, while bestowing life is far from simple. You see this land? It is empty and lifeless. It will take time for the first plants will appear, for the flowers to blossom, and the trees to reach for the sky. Anyone with an understanding of life can bestow it, but also may take it away.
I'll give you a little hint. When you meet Life Incarnate, remember these words. Under certain conditions, that which gives life may also take life away. Now go into the Heart of Life, and show your Power of Intention.
Go and only come back with victory!

Very nice. By turning the gift of life against your opponent you've demonstrated tremendous Power of Intention.
With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!
While in the astral body, defeat Darkness Incarnate in the Heart of Darkness and return to the Keeper of the Universe.

Darkness and shadow... They conceal a killer waylaying his victim, but also lovers as they seclude themselves, away from noise and others. Darkness is full of fear and deceit, but it also brings solace and conceals dirt that is so apparent in daylight. Without darkness there is no light, and without light there is no darkness. And when darkness and light come together, shadow is born.
My words will help you demonstrate the Power of Intention in the Heart of Darkness. This glowing dust that I'm giving you will help you to find what the darkness hides.
Go and only come back with victory!

Congratulations on the victory. Now you know that where there is light, there must also be darkness. And where darkness reigns, there must also be light. Or to put it another way... Darkness and Light! Use the light when you need to overcome darkness, and call out to the darkness when your opponent draws on the light. This will always ensure your victory.
In a duel between light and darkness, you've demonstrated your Power of Intention very well. With your desire incarnate, you are one step closer to the Dead City!
Meet with Barbara of Siveria on the Isle of Revelation.

I want to give you a very important task. The Empire's fate might depend on it! Maybe even the fate of the whole world...
What do you know about Nihaz? He's a god. A dark god, as he himself admits. But what do we know of his goals? For the sake of keeping Sarn imprisoned, he might decide to destroy everything that the Sarnaut's prisoner created, including us. In fact, this might very well turn out to be the case. You are nothing but a pawn to him, like all the rest of the Keepers of the Revelation and the Seekers of Truth. I know all too well how powerful beings such as him tend to have their own sense of right and wrong. So long as his goals and capabilities remain unknown to us, he represents a potential threat to our entire world.
But this is all conjecture. And I won't act on conjecture! I need facts! The Committee's agents were able to recruit one Barbara of Siveria, who spends a great deal of time on the Isle of Revelation, not far from the Citadel. With her help, we can get more information about the Master's plans and designs. Therein lies your task. Go see Barbara of Siveria and do everything you can. The Empire shall never forget you!
So you're going to be my contact in the Committee? Then quit acting so suspiciously, or else you might as well write "spy" on your forehead.
Meet with Barbara of Siveria on the Isle of Revelation.

I want to give you a very important task. The League's fate might depend on it! Maybe even the fate of the whole world...
What do you know about Nihaz? He's a god. A dark god, as he himself admits. But what do we know of his goals? For the sake of keeping Sarn imprisoned, he might decide to destroy everything that the Sarnaut's prisoner created, including us. In fact, this might very well turn out to be the case. You are nothing but a pawn to him, like all the rest of the Keepers of the Revelation and the Seekers of Truth. I know all too well how powerful beings such as him tend to have their own sense of right and wrong. So long as his goals and capabilities remain unknown to us, he represents a potential threat to our entire world.
But this is all conjecture. And I won't act on conjecture! I need facts! Barbara of Siveria, our secret agent, spends a great deal of time on the Isle of Revelation, not far from the Citadel. With her help, we can get more information about the Master's plans and designs. Therein lies your task. Go see Barbara of Siveria and do everything you can. The League shall never forget you!
So you're the hero that was sent to me to help gather information about the Master! Then quit acting so suspiciously, or else you might as well write "spy" on your forehead.
Carry out orders of Nihaz's and his retainers until you are offered to help the Architect at the Citadel docks, then learn about the construction project and return to Barbara of Siveria.

Here's the deal. The Master's servants recently built something on the docks. Lots of astral ships were coming and going, carrying heavy cargo and equipment. What I've heard is that they are planning to install generators and other machinery in the astral near the Citadel. Unfortunately, that's all I was able to learn. Those runty little hooded creeps prefer to keep their lips sealed... But they seem to trust you!
You're on good terms with the Master and his minions, and I'd bet a plugged nickel against all the diamonds in the world that they'll invite you to see their construction. Don't hesitate to accept! Do all of the Master's bidding, and look, listen, and remember. Return to me as soon as you've figured out what the Master is doing.

What?? Nihaz got you helping him on the construction of a new allod? That's unbelievable... Do you understand how valuable this information is? Any Great Mage would give his right arm for information about the principles of constructing new islands!
All right, let's have some details. I'll write it all down and then send a letter to our mutual employer...
Bring Barbara of Siveria pure astralium.

Let's see... You're saying that something called "astralium" is needed for the construction of the new island? That would probably interest our Great Mage... And you know what? I don't think it will be a problem to obtain some. Master's henchmen are obviously rather dumb.
It's unlikely that you'll be able to learn what purification technology they use, but it shouldn't be much work to get some astralium itself. They are not keeping records, right? Get a piece of astralium and bring it to me. I will send it to the capital, and I'm happy to let the mages and scientists have at it.
Not so much noise! Even the stumps have ears...

Shh... Bring it here. I hope it doesn't explode.
Nice and easy. Continue to carry out the Master's orders, help him build the Cradle, work your way into his trust and gather information. If something unprofessional should happen - an accident, sabotage, or what have you - come straight to me.
Find three samples of material, five pages of notes, and a logbook containing the research of Yaver Duakh. Then return to Barbara of Siveria.

Damn! The cultists sure chose a good time to muck things up! Now they'll probably improve security and start keeping an eye on the area around the construction site. What are we to do now?
Wait a second... They're probably going to send you in pursuit of the cultists, if they haven't already. Right? That makes things easier. The blades you just met were gathering samples of the materials that were subjected to the generators' radiation, so Tep's disciples have probably already had a chance to study them thoroughly. So we just have to utilize the products of their labor!
Find boxes of material samples on the Frozen Peak and smuggle three of them away. If you end up having to fight the disciples, be sure to take any written materials you find regarding the Cradle's construction. Most importantly, try to locate their leader. I know that every single one of the Arisen researchers keeps a logbook. We could save a ton of time if you manage to get your hooks on one. Then we wouldn't have to reinvent the wheel.
Tep's cultists certainly picked a nice time to interfere... They'll soon pay!

Samples... Pages of notes... Aha, a complete researcher's logbook! Excellent!
I'll try to get this information to the capital as soon as possible.
Collect fragments of the Tep cultist's outfit, don the outfit, then kill the courier and take the Master's orders he carries. Then return to Barbara of Siveria.

I have another idea... You're not going to like it. I can't say I like it too much myself, but if this works, our success will be guaranteed.
I noticed that messages between the Master and the Architect travel back and forth by courier. He's always got a thick folder of papers, maps, diagrams, and construction orders. I'd sure like to get my hands on that folder! And those Tep cultists, who interfered in the Cradle's construction at the worst possible time, they can help us find these papers.
The courier's death is likely to arouse suspicion. But if his murderer resembles one of Tep's cultists, then Tep will take all the blame instead of us. Go to the Frozen Peak, find a cultist mantle, mask, and raincoat. Then kill the courier.
Don't think anything of the fact that you had to spill the blood of an innocent, for on this depends the fate of those you care about!

You did well! I heard one of the Citadel guards threaten to rip the Tep cultists' heads off in payback for the death of the courier. Haha! Just as I planned, all suspicions fell on Tep. That's what I call clean work!
Using the ferrotype camera, take photos of the Heart of Power, the geyser, and the broken cube on the Cradle. Then return to Barbara of Siveria.

Now we've got almost all the basic principles of allod creation. Now we must wait until construction is complete so we can see the results. Once we see the results for ourselves, I want to share what we see with others, so that they know that allod creation is not something we've made up. For that we're going to need to use your trusty ferrotype camera.
Wait until the Cradle is complete, then take your ferrotype camera there and take photos of the most notable parts of the island. With these photos, plus the data we collected from the cultists, and the orders issued by the Master himself, our researchers will be able to develop a complete understanding of the construction!
Just don't let the Master's disciples catch you carrying your ferrotype camera. They're not going to believe you if you tell them you're just there for the scenery...

Let's see. Some sort of cube... A geyser... But what's this dome?
Ah well, it's not for me to figure out. I'll pass your photos along to the researchers. Let them figure it all out.

I think you remember your venture at the Cradle. Unfortunately, the data you gathered there have been leaked to the League.

In any event, the intelligence you gathered for us is invaluable. All the researchers at ZIT Headquarters have spent days on end studying the information you provided. We've already got a rough idea of how to create new matter from the astral! This research shows such promise! The possibilities are endless. Earlier scientific discoveries pale in comparison. And we have you to thank for this breakthrough.
Great deeds deserve to be greatly rewarded!

Only a select few before you have merited receiving this honor, and every one of them has become known throughout the Empire as a real-life hero! I hope you are ready to add your name to the rolls of the Empire's heroes, alongside our greatest warriors, mages, and scientists... There's no going back now.

I think you remember your venture at the Cradle. Unfortunately, the data you got there have been leaked to the Empire.

In any event, the intelligence you gathered is absolutely priceless. The best researchers of the elven houses have spent days on end studying the results of your reconnaissance. We've already got a rough idea of how to create new matter from the astral! This research shows such promise! The possibilities are endless. Earlier scientific discoveries pale in comparison. And we have you to thank for this breakthrough.
Great deeds deserve to be greatly rewarded!

Only a select few before you have merited receiving this honor, and every one of them has become known throughout the League as a great hero! I hope you are ready to add your name to the rolls of the League's heroes, joining our greatest rulers, warriors, mages, and scientists... There's no going back now.
Well, how did it go? Time is money!

So, these are the baubles! They are so small and unremarkable... From far off they looked alright, they seemed expensive. Fine, a deal is a deal, I will find a use even for these unremarkable items. Take your Astralium and remember - we are honest traders, we do not cheat our business partners!

Help your country's heroine to defeat the enemy heroine and return to the Keeper of the Universe at the Cradle portal.
In order to receive the reward, you must have the maximum amount of the Striving for Victory effect by the moment of defeating the enemy heroine!

I have interesting news for you. As I've recently learned here in the Cradle, there is an ongoing resistance against not only the Master's faithful and their enemies, but against the League and the Empire as well. More specifically, against each side's endeavors to be the first to reach the Dead City. And it manifests in images of Elizaveta Rysina, the leader of the Committee, and Marianne de Ardeur, the head of the Church of Light, showing up occasionally in an area the northwest of here. And the opposition to these endeavors takes the form of a magical duel between these two prominent ladies... Indeed, this acrimony runs deep and isn't easy to solve overnight. But it's a good thing! The Master does not need weaklings. Only the stronger will merit learning the secrets of the Dead City! And this battle of intentions, the duel of wills and desires, makes it possible to avoid a bloody war that would take away thousands of lives, while revealing those the one who is most worthy.
If you want to help your country and your people, then head to the area northwest of the portal at the time specified in your calendar, and wait. When the duel of intentions incarnate commences, you are free to join in and assist the heroine of your people. But bear in mind that your opponents will most certainly try to do the same thing, so I would advise that you gather up loyal friends before rushing into battle!
I wonder who will first set foot in the Dead City, a representative of the League or the Empire? While I personally hope that the two sides will still come to terms and unite against a common threat.

Congratulations on the victory! But don't get too full of yourself - today your will turned out the stronger, but who knows what tomorrow may bring? So, return to me if you feel the urge to fight for the honor of your people and your country.
Please hurry! The damaged cubes are greatly hampering my work.

Excellent! I knew you'd be able to do the job. This will grant me at least a temporary relief from the headache that comes with repairing the damaged cubes.
If you want to help me repair them again, come back at the time specified in your calendar and I'll give you a new assignment.
Find a geyser at the edge of the Cradle, collect mineral samples, and hurry back to the Keeper of the Universe before the samples disappear!

I have another task for you.
You see, to control the formation of a new land, we must be aware of what is happening within its depths. On the surface everything is clear, but seeing the processes that take place in the bowels of the created allod is very difficult. You can, of course, drill a super-deep shaft into the allod and see it all for yourself, but that is not the best way.
Here on the Cradle there's fading volcanic activity within the allod. After all, we created it in the image of an entire planet, not just some piece of rock. But the geysers that erupt with jets of hot steam will help us to figure out what's going on deep within the Cradle!
Find a geyser and collect minerals particles that the jets carry to the surface. And then run back here as fast as you can! Delay and all your samples will be rendered useless. Also, it would be best to gather samples together with other players. Wit someone at your side you'll be able to run back faster. If you lose your way or sprain your ankle, your companion will be there to support you... And you'll be able to deliver more samples. So gather up your friends... or better yet, call your guildmates, for by helping me you will raise prestige for your guild!
So, where are the mineral samples? Give them to me quick, while they are still suitable for research!

Hurray! Now I can compare samples of minerals from the depths of the earth against those from the surface, whereupon I will be able to say for certain whether the Cradle's formation is coming along correctly.
Go through the portal and meet with Nihaz in the Dead City.

The Dead City... Your researchers consider it to be the last remnant of June civilization. But it is more than just another relic! It's a knot connecting the universe's past and the future. And he who cuts this knot in two will decide the fate of Sarnaut!
Now go. The Master is waiting for you in the Dead City. Heed his words. Every one of them has the power to change the universe forever.
I see you're not running off just yet... Could it be your lust for the secrets of the past has waned? No? Then listen carefully.
Go through the portal and meet Nihaz in the Dead City.

The Dead City... Your researchers consider it to be the last remnant of June civilization. But it is more than just another relic! It's a knot connecting the universe's past and the future. And he who cuts this knot in two will decide the fate of Sarnaut!
Now go. The Master is waiting for you in the Dead City. Heed his words. Every one of them has the power to change the universe forever.
I see you're not running off just yet... Could it be your lust for the secrets of the past has waned? No? Then listen carefully.
Only by defeating the Guardian will you gain access to the portal
Bring 5 Rare Light Tablecloths to Yaver Kamose.

Ah! It just came to my mind that one thing we're low on are new tablecloths.
We rarely order additional supplies since we normally spend most of our time with our research, but after the issues with the rats, the loose yak, and the pyramid activating - well, we're definitely in need of replacing these torn rags.
You don't happen to be an experienced tailor, do you? Don't worry, I'm not asking for a luxury product, I'm just asking for a few tablecloths to help us out. Think you can bring us a few?
Tailoring isn't your cup of tea? No worries, perhaps you can buy us a few.
Excellent! I know it may seem like just a small amount, but your help goes a long ways!
Find the 3 Stones of ZIT Headquarters and report back to anthropologist Sarbaz Merti.

To be able to call oneself a true scholar, one must be very aware of one's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed three stones imbued with magic around ZIT Headquarters. Explore these great allods, find the stones, and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the OMUT Division, AD Division, and TaPS Division. Good luck, traveler.
What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.
Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!
Collect 4 ZIT Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Sarbaz Merti.

Listen, I know you're a seasoned traveler, but this is ZIT!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill four of ZIT's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Scabbers, a squall elemental, a daddy sand spider, a burning elemental, a graceful twilight harpy, an advanced necro-yak or a ravenous experimental zombie will do just fine.
How did you fair? Are you fearless yet?

Excellent!
Those beasts have been defeated and these trophies you've gathered prove it!
Kill 50 Harpies for anthropologist Sarbaz Merti.

I'll keep this short. The harpies here on ZIT Headquarters are a pain in the neck.
They're always flying around, rubbing themselves, and attacking our junior scientists! We have more important things to worry about thank some over-sexed bird ladies! Get out there and take care of those distractions!
I hope you've taught those harlots a lesson.
Thank you, hopefully we'll be able to get some work done now.
Collect 5 Tablet Shards for anthropologist Sarbaz Merti.

There are many things that are of value in this world, but there is something that stands above all else. Above herbs and precious stones!
No, the most valuable thing in the world is knowledge.
There are ancient tablets here on ZIT that hold the mysteries of our people. Unfortunately, they're in pieces. We need to collect the pieces of the tablets so that we can put them back together to add to our libraries!
You can find those shards all over ZIT if you look hard enough...
Thank you! This will be a great help to the arisen.
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Sarbaz Merti.

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here on ZIT Headquarters!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Great.
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
Speak to Negus Tot, the director of the ZIT.

Isn't it something? A real beauty! Not sure what I'm referring to? I'm talking about Tep's Pyramid, of course!
The greatest achievement of the Zem people! Four faces - four cardinal points. It's a symbol of great innovation into the Astral! And, no... We're not throwing buried treasures at the bottom of the pyramid. Where are these rumors coming from anyway?
Sometimes I find myself completely mesmerized by the magnificence of Tep's pyramid!
Oh, in a hurry are you? Well listen carefully, something happened inside and to make a long story short we've quarantined a number of parts of the institute. Go speak to the Director of the ZIT, Negus Tot. He'll give you more information on the quarantine.
Yes, go ahead. But speak quickly, we're really busy here!

Fresh faces and an extra set of eyes! Just what we need! For many years the pyramid was believed to be dead, but what is death? Isn't it the same as sleep? Ah, pardon the philosophical tangent, we still need your help locating the sparks.
Catch 4 Sparks and return to Negus Tot.

It's been many years since this Pyramid was in active use. In some ways it's not surprising that once we activated it there were a number of issues that arose. We believed that upon activation, we would be able to control the accumulation of sparks, instead the opposite occurred and the pyramid began ejecting sparks throughout the entire allod.
There's no need to worry, all stations are hard at work determining what happened and looking for a number of suitable solutions for this situation.
In the meantime, there's a large number of restless Zem souls that are just lingering in and around the Institute. They're not harmful, but every spark is extremely precious to us! As you know, there's only a small number of Arisen remaining in the allods, plus, many bodies have not been preserved and if we don't obtain the sparks soon they will never be reborn.
That's why anyone who can provide a helping hand needs to help us retrieve these wandering sparks. How exactly do you catch a spark? Good question. Here at the Zem Institute of Technology we've developed an invention called the "Sparkton Pack". It's easily portable, light-weight, and works with minimal assistance.
You should have seen the alpha version of the Sparkton Pack! It was big, clunky, and weighed a ton. First you'd have to aim and activate a device to keep the spark from moving, and then you'd have to somehow toss out the trapping device just to retrieve them safely. I'm glad that the ZIT has made a significant improvement on it!
Ah, one issue with the Sparkton Pack is that it only activates through the energy that the Pyramid gives off. Unfortunately, you'll have to be in close proximity to the spark in other to retrieve it.

Four Sparks are saved thanks to you. But we can't relax just yet.
Here. This is a new version of Sparkton Pack. We just made it. I'll explain what you need to do.
Catch 15 sparks and report to Negus Tot.

Unfortunately, there are still Sparks that need to be collected, so use the new Sparkton Pack. It has greater capacity. If you catch fifteen sparks, you'll get a bonus.

There is something about these Sparks... The pyramid has started working, and some of the ancient artifacts of Tep have awakened - the teleporters, for example. We already know how to use them. There is just one problem: they require Sparks. Don't worry, this won't harm the Sparks themselves: they just need to be close to the machines. But remember this: each spark returned to the Storage gives the deceased a chance to be revived and also supplies our laboratory with precious kilowatt-hours!
Don't be in a hurry, just collect the sparks as you see them.

Excellent job! We originally had a nice Astral ship cruise planned for you! We wanted to sail you off near some of the more friendly areas in the Kanian archipelagos but it just didn't pan out. Don't worry though, we still have a pretty generous bonus for you!
Use the portal field regulators in all of the divisions of the ZIT Headquarters and report back to Sarang Senusret.

I'm so glad that we've abandoned all hope for fixing the teleporter's behavior. Trying to repair it is pointless - it needs to be massively redesigned. Fortunately, I've been working on the project for quite some time now.
Portal field regulators need to be installed at multiple locations. They will correct the teleporter's behavior so that it will perform as described. Still we'll have to answer the question why they failed... Was it a design fault or sabotage? So you better look around while searching for places where to install the regulators. If you spot something strange, tell me immediately, it may be valuable for the science!
You'll be teleporting to all the wrong places until you install those regulators.

And... the portal works now! You must admit, that was some pretty good engineering. But for the sabotage!..
I wonder who's the culprit. It cannot be the League, and it's unlikely someone from the Empire would do this...
Kill 4 Scavenging or Famished Rats and report back to Yasskul Pentawer.

It's ridiculous how this entire mess just got slammed right on the LAD Division's lap! It's quite frustrating since we always manage our work very well. You know how many sparks we get returned to their bodies? Three to four hundred per month! That's a damn good number I tell you!
I'm not going to point at other divisions that just guzzle away at resources, but there's definitely some that don't pay attention to how their people are managed. What irks me the most is how much progress we made prior to all of this mess.
Now we have hundreds if not thousands of sparks flying all over the place! And where do they expect us to get bodies for all of them? Corpses are being dug up and brought to the pyramid at a slower rate, and can you guess what new problem we ran into? Rats!
These little rats over here feeding on our beloved countrymen and none of the other lazy divisions are doing anything about it! Oh how I miss working with the Imperial Army, a disaster like this would have been completely avoided.
What are you doing anyway? Why don't you lend us a hand? Go to the LAD Division and start killing those damned rats. We have a teleporter that goes between the departments. That is, we used to until a team from another department broke the damn thing.
Plowing through those rats yet? Yeah, don't even bother with a mouse trap.
The rats have been destroyed? Good work! You'd fit right in with the LAD Division. You should consider applying.
Carry three Heavy Sarcophagi into the empty crypts and return to Yaver Satiah.

Oh my, I wish I could be lying in a sarcophagus myself right now. When will this end? Once again they have piled everything on my shoulders. I feel like my arms are going to rip right off when I lift these things.
I'm talking about these sarcophagi that hold our brothers and sisters. They need to be delivered all over the place. Unfortunately, this is easier said than done. I just can't do this anymore! I just can't!
Listen... Could you maybe drag at least three of them over there? That'll give me time to catch my breath. Please? If Yasskul Pentawer sees that no one is carrying the sarcophagi, he's going to get really angry.
I'm not sure what he'd do exactly, but judging by the look in his eyes, it's something more horrible than life in a mortal body... So, will you move three sarcophagi for me?
These things are so unbelievably heavy!
Thanks for your help! As I stood here, I started thinking - why don't we just take the bodies out of the sarcophagi and put them in something lighter? Who came up with such nonsense?
Collect 4 Mummified Spiders for Negus Tot.

Yeah, everyone knows that the LAD Division has the largest workload. And on top of that, they had to deal with that nasty rat infestation.

I spent some time trying to figure out a long-term solution that's better than just mindlessly destroying the rats. We have spiders at the Headquarters - we bred them ourselves. Yes! Because rats and spiders are bitter enemies and usually stay out of each other's territory. However, when corpses were brought in, the rats went wild, so the spiders are cowering in the corners in terror. Something needs to be done about this!

Let's trick the rodents.

If you can kill several spiders and mummify them, we could use their corpses to scare the rats off for good! Do you think you can help us with this?

Here, you're going to need this mummification balm. Use this generously on ten spiders' corpses and they will remain well preserved. And keep in mind: a quality mummy requires skill! Once you have four mummies, bring them to me. I'll have the lab technicians place them in the crypts.
The mummifying balm will probably stick to your hands for a few days, but don't worry, it'll wear off eventually.
See! While I admit the LAD Division has their plate full, it'd be nice if they'd properly manage their workload rather than just getting frustrated at all the work they have to do.
Obtain 4 Scorpion Shells for Nomarkh Imhotep.

Hah! I knew it! I absolutely knew it!
This one's for all of those naysayers that doubted me!
It feels so good to be right and rub it in their faces. I, the great Imkhoten, predicted that under the right circumstances Tep's Pyramid would eventually awaken. I predicted this! Me! Not you or any of the other division heads, me!
You know who I can't wait to see? That useless brute Yasskul Pentawer. What has he ever done for our institution? What exactly did he do that was so great that he received his own division? To think that I have to share this allod with him! It feels good to have my theories proven right. How did I know that Tep's Pyramid would finally reawaken? I saw it in the pattern on the scorpion shells. It's what allows me to predict the future accurately.
What, don't believe me? I can make another prediction. I can tell you what awaits us in the future and how all this is all going to end. First, I need you to bring me some shells. The scorpions can be found near the MP Division.
My colleagues will no longer laugh at the MP Division or at Imkhoten. I will be the one who leads the institution with prophecies!

Thank you. Still looking for me to prove that I can read the future with the scorpion shells? Okay, give me a moment... Hm...
Unbelievable! A terrible darkness is coming! The entire Empire will tremble! That tyrant, Tep, is watching us every day! He's headed here, to the pyramid! What a morbid feeling...
Touch 4 Twilight Harpies with the Enchanted Love Ring and return to Yaver Rahotep.

Eh... What department am I from? Hm, how should I say this... Oh, fine... I'll tell you. I'm from the Monster Prognostics department. What? You're not laughing? Usually when I tell someone that, they start laughing and calling me crazy.
I'm busy with a new nonsense, a new direction in science - predicting the behavior of semi-sentient beings. If, for example, a twilight harpy stands on its left leg in the morning, then the Empire will prevail in the war with the League... But if it stands on the right leg, the Empire will still win, but it will take longer.
This is all pure theory for now. Anyway, how can you observe the harpies properly if those horrible creatures won't let anyone go near them? That's why we've decided to tame them. Or rather, Nomarkh Imhotep has decided to tame them, and Yaver Rahotep has to go along with it.
I thought long and hard to come up with something to accomplish this. Yesterday it finally dawned on me - love magic. And why not? If it's possible to force sentient beings to fall in love with someone, then why not harpies? The thing is, I need a good soldier to apply the charm. Needless to say, these monsters are not exactly burning with amorous intentions. So when it throws itself at you, show it this ring, it will pacify it instantly... Maybe. Maybe not.
How did everything go? The harpies didn't try to seduce you, did they? To tell you the truth, I've never tried this method before...
Doesn't your conscience trouble you at all? How many of those harpies are now in love with you? Haha, I'm only joking. Thank you for your help!
Search for Nomarkh Lalulalu's double and take readings from 3 Astralometers.

Hey, it's me! Where have you been!? Hm, wait a second - you're not me! You're not my double!
Where is my double, anyway? You haven't seen a person that looks just like me, have you? Well, he doesn't look exactly like me. His face won't have the same expression of worry as mine does.
After all, a double is only a copy of one's physical attributes. A double is only given enough brains to complete small tasks - it's not a person that can think outside the box.
You see, we plan on starting a new mana station on this allod. I sent my double to measure the energy levels on the Astral shore. Unfortunately, it's been quite a while since I've last seen him and I'm worried that he's floated off into the Astral.
Can you do me a favor? Could you go search for my double? Also, in the event that he ended up being too lazy to complete this tiny little errand, do you mind taking Astralometer readings for me? Thanks so much, I really appreciate it!
Did you find my double yet? What about those readings?

What? My double is refusing?! He wants to spend time building relationships and talking to people? He developed a mind of his own?! This is ridiculous! I need to think of a way to properly deactivate him if he continues to refuse my orders.
Bring the teleportation map to the Portal Keeper Sarang Senusret outside Tep's Pyramid.

There has to be some kind of pattern. There must be!
Look, according to my map... in around 25% of cases I came out at the LAD Division, the same number of times at the MP Division, the same at the TaPS Division and the same again to the AD Division. What can we conclude from that?
I've never even been to the OMUT Division! And to be honest, I'd noticed that myself... even without the map. What was the sequence in which the portal shunted me between the different points? Hmm...
If you look at the diagram I've drawn we can see... we can see... no, nothing makes sense... At least we now have a map. I've now been through the portal more than one hundred times! Be so good as to take this map to the Portal Keeper... I'm not sure that I want to see his face right now.

What in the world is this? A web spinned by some crazy spider? All lines are mixed up!
Oh, this is a teleportation chart made by Sarbaz Anen... Alright, give it to me.

What's this? It looks like a tangled web, woven by a spider that's crazy, blind and lame in two of its legs? Aha, it's a map of the teleport system... I got it from Sarbaz Anen... Good, give it here and let's have a look.
The only thing that's clear is that nothing is clear. It turns out there is no system. Conclusion - making use of the portals is impossible.
Bring 4 pieces of Necro-Yak Meat to Yaver Kamose.

I cannot believe what has happened! I feel as though I've brought great shame to the TaPS Division.
I'm really going to need your help here! The lab staff is on a critical deadline towards advancing their science with the undead. One resource they need is a special yak meat that's harvested from the Necro-Yak's that I was in charge of!
I have no idea how they escaped! I was diligent about preparing the proper security measures to make sure that the yak remained confined, but they somehow managed to escape and now they're freely grazing the entire allod!
Look, obtaining the meat is more important than herding all of the Yak back together. For the sake of the TaPS Division and our science I need you to obtain the yak meat for me. You'll do this for me, won't you?!

This is embarrassing! In fact, I've brought such great shame that I wrote letter of resignation and submitted it directly to Negus Tot. I have no idea why, but he decided to reject it!
What do you suppose I shall do?

You don't want me to write it down for you? Do we have any yak meat?
Oh! That means I'm saved!
Bring Special Agent David Proshin the Invigorating Balm, a Mage's Ring, and some Interrogation Tongs from the TaPS Division.

Soon the head will thaw out and we'll be able to begin the reanimation process and then the interrogation.
We'll need the following: reanimation balm, a mage's ring, and interrogation tongs. You can find these and many other things in the chests at TaPS - The Technical and Provisions Supply department. There is one "but" to this situation. I've heard that something strange has been happening there. They say the weapons have come to life.
But what can we do about that? Get yourself over there and find all the items that we need.
The head thawed out long ago. It will soon start to rit. Hurry up if you want to have any chance of fishing anything out of there!
So, we've got everything that we need... Let's get started. Step back, this is not a sight for the faint of heart.
Wait until the interrogation is over and speak with David Proshin.

Alright, now I'm going to try to pull out the information.
The hoop goes on, just like that... Now a drop of invigorating balm...
Tongs... Hmm, why tongs? Well, I guess I just ordered 'em out of habit! We won't need them here.
Now I will fall into a trance and pull out the information. Hold on just a little longer.
Kill 4 Tep Blades and return to Sarbaz Khakheperre.

Are they still flying? The... blades. I asked to be appointed here so I could look after the animals, away from war and further bloodshed. Alternative service, you might call it.
I think one death is enough for me. We Arisen must not inflict death. I'm not a coward, I'm a pacifist.
But they still found me! The flying blades! Where did they come from?!
I can't fight, my hand is shaking... I beg you, please clear the way for me. Go and destroy at least four of those Tep blades so I can make my way to the portal.
Has the way been cleared? Am I free to make a run for it now?
Thank you. That's it. I'm out of here! And I advise you not to hang around here either!
Bring the invitation to Yasskul Djedefre, the head of the AD Division.

Has anyone seen Yasskul Djedefre? We've been waiting on him for ages!
I am completely aware that the AD Division has their plates full, but when I call for a council meeting I expect all of my division heads to be here, deciding not to attend is not an option! We have a ton of issues to discuss!
Many of the ZIT employees are confused over what's happening and they need leadership and guidance from the division heads, which is why I called for the damn council meeting to begin with!
I am growing impatient and his presence is required for this meeting! Can you please do me a favor and check to see if he's still lingering in the AD Division? Tell him that he's keeping everyone waiting and that we won't start until he's here!
Please do not distract me! Every moment wasted takes a direct hit to the Imperial budget!

What council meeting? What are you talking about? I'm busy here!
The council meeting was probably called on by one of the department heads! I hate these council meetings! They lavishly use our resources and bask on a number of gratuitous accoutrements that tie directly into the Imperial budget! I don't have time for this as there are far more important matters to be dealt with!
Use the June ruins to travel from the TaPS Division to the AD Division.

Did you hear about the properties of the June ruins? They can create a sphere that will move you from one point to the other. The best part is that the spheres protect you from anything - even the Astral!
We even have several June ruins around here. They were brought specifically to us so we could experiment on them. We hope to be able to build them ourselves one day.
If you need to travel between the allods around here make sure to find some June ruins. I even use them for fun sometimes. Floating along in the Astral soothes my nerves! I recommend you try it!
I wouldn't mind riding in this thing all day! But now isn't the time for jokes, I suppose.
I knew you'd get the hang of them pretty fast. They're actually quite easy to use. Just touch them and zoom - you're off!
Collect Experimental Amulets from the Experimental Zombies. Bring 4 of them to Yasskul Djedefre.

Look, I'm working on a highly classified project that I cannot reveal too many details on. What I can tell you is that the experiments were conducted on existing zombies. Early test results were moving along according to plan, however, the zombies began to disappear and we started to lose track on a number of our test subjects.
Eventually, the zombies reappeared and were actually quite aggressive. At this point it would actually be more troublesome for me to devise some sort of procedure to calm down their aggression - it would be much more efficient if you could destroy the zombies for me.
Ah, one more thing, I need the amulets the zombies were carrying as they were also part of the experiment.

A large part of the Empire's breakthrough is due to the ZIT, more specifically, the AD Division. We developed the Astral ships that you know of today. We've developed so much new technology that I can't even tell my wife about since all documents are to be held classified for hundreds of years!
You have the amulets? What? You are familiar with them? That's impossible!
Report what you learned to Negus Tot, the Director of the ZIT.

The amulets are empty! They contained a spell, a long spell with several components and replanting it would take months of work!
Where did it go? Without the spell, these amulets are nothing more than useless trinkets!
What the is going on?! Some strange things have been happening in the institute recently! Report everything that happened to Yasskul Tot and explain that I'm unlikely to appear at the Council in the next century!

How dare he? Regular attendance of Council meetings is clearly defined as part of his job description...
What!? The magic is missing from the experimental amulets?!
Yes... that's a valid explanation!
Shocking! That's terrible!
Use the Energy Trap to collect energy from 4 Elementals for Yaver Nebiriau.

Everything for the army, everything for victory! The Astral is the basis of the Empire's power and I'm proud to be working for the AD Division. Every citizen should feel pride in helping science and their community and I just happen to be part of our scientific community!
My current job is to seek out energy for the Empire wherever it may be. And then it hit me - elementals! My initiative is supported by the decision makers at the very top and I have been authorized to involve anyone who can help - including you.
Here, take this energy trap. You must place it next to an elemental and kill it quickly while the trap is still on. It's new technology that's obviously still far from perfect, but that's the problem we're trying to work out as we speak.
My current project revolves around constructing a trap that will cause elementals to die as soon as it's in range. If it sounds like a tall order, it is! Unfortunately, until I can deliver the future of the Empire's energy supply is in your hands!
You can never have too much energy, you know.
I will go down in history as one of the Empire's best scientists! And your help... well, it will always be remembered by me.
Charge the Spark Catcher with 3 Sparks and collect 3 Astral Crystals for Sarang Meritneith.

Hey you with the Sparkton Pack, quit wasting time and get to the shore with the other spark catchers. What? Didn't Negus Tot tell you? Helping research is only part of the job. The AD Division is working on an order for Yasker himself and we need volunteers like you to catch sparks.
It's pretty simple - you catch a few sparks with the Sparkton Pack and then send a powerful charge straight into the Astral. The sparks will be returned to you in the shape of an Astral meteor. Come back once you've have 3 meteors.
Spotting a spark catcher is easy enough - we've made it out of your regular Astral hand cannon. That's how we roll - we take whatever's lying around and turn it into something useful. Incidentally, that's also the main principle of magic.
I can't quite remember - did I warn you that in rare cases, the charge might grab an Astral demon instead of a meteor?
Well, look at that... You're still in one piece and with a backpack full of Astral meteors. Good job.
Show the Demon-Ingested Spark to Yasskul Djedefre, the head of the AD Division.
What's this? It looks like this spark attracted a demon from the Astral. Is this normal? It seems to have mutated slightly... We better report this to Yasskul Djedefre, just in case.
Where in the Astral did you find this?

Where did you get this spark? It's been inside a demon?
I have waited for this for a long time. Give it to me and let me deal with it.
Destroy 4 Sharpened Tep Blades and capture their Sparks using the Sparkton Pack 2.0 for Yaver Khufu.

Is Tep alive or dead? That's the question that's going through everyone's mind. Though, one thing people should really consider is what being "alive" even means.
Take the Arisen for instance - are they undead beings? Yes. Do they walk, move, talk, or have some sort of conscious? They do. One could argue that the Arisen are perfectly alive, but others would argue that we're not.
My apologies, I went into a bit of a tangent there. In any case, do I have an excellent assignment for you! The Sparkton Pack version two is ready to go. One major modification is that it only works with non-living objects. I want you to head to the OMUT Division and test out the new Sparkton pack.
You'll notice a handful of Tep blades that have gone completely haywire. I suspect that spark's have taken control of each Tep blade.
Destroy the Tep blades, free the spark, and collect it with the new Sparkton Pack.
It'd be great to hear your thoughts on the Sparkton Pack version 2.0 especially when compared to the original Sparkton Pack.

As I suspected, the blades contained sparks. However, this is very odd, these are sparks that appear to have originated from the Pyramid repository. These sparks are also quite aggressive, and frankly speaking, uncontrollable.
Hm, this is just a hunch, but these sparks look to be drained by Tep himself, probably during his quest for immortality. According to Tep's research, he indicated that drained sparks can be very dangerous. He also mentions how draining sparks have a reverse affect to whoever begins to suck out its life essence.
Collect OMUT Division Reports and bring them to Yaver Sitamun. You need to bring her 4 reports.

Ah! At last someone has come to our aid! The portals are down and there's no way to escape the allod! We're doomed! Phew, let me catch my breath and I'll explain everything.
Alright, listen up. They came here on an Astral ship, landing on the northern shore. They summoned up fire elementals and set them on us! Some of our lab workers died... but the worst of it all is that our archives were destroyed! Razed to the ground!
I can't believe we lost decades worth of our blood, sweat, and tears, everything we've ever learned about Tep! Oh, almighty Astral... Who are "they"? Tep cultists, of course! Who else?!
We tried to save some of the archives as we escaped, but we didn't get many. There are still tons of reports scattered throughout the allod. Find them and bring them to me. Any scrap of paper you find may help us to reconstruct our archives.
Make sure you steer clear of those fire elementals. They're the ones burning down our tomes and manuscripts, destroying all of our departments' achievements! They're terrible creatures!
I would go collect some myself, but what can a humble researcher do against a fire elemental?
The reports have been saved! Oh, thank you so much! Here, take this reward.
Eliminate 2 Sharpened Tep Blades, 2 Flame Elementals, and the Tep Worshipper for Sarang Neithhotep.

We can't stay holed up in this crypt forever! We must act!
Oh, what am I talking about... We can't handle them! Especially if one of them is a conjurer! He was the one who summoned the elementals. And all the other Tep cultists take their orders from him. Even more horrifying is the fact that the Tep blades also obeyed him and submitted to his will. Those blades are Tep and his followers' doing, no doubt about it now.
Are you brave enough to challenge their might?
Lab assistants are hiding in their labs like rats. How am I supposed to save the institute alone?
Let me shake your hand! Thank you! We could never have done it without you. I will vote for placing your portrait under the Best Institute Employee for the Last Quarter heading on our board of honor.
Report to Negus Tot at Tep's Pyramid.

Do the rest of the scientists at the ZIT know about the attack? I wanted to teleport to the main pyramid and warn them, but then... they appeared! They were servants of Tep and they had a massive sarcophagus with them!
I hid around a corner and waited for them to disappear through the portal... But when I came back it didn't work anymore! We must warn the director immediately! Something terrible is about to happen, I just know it! Please warn Negus Tot!

What happened? What's with that look? What? Tep's servants are roaming the institute unchecked? I never thought I'd live to see that! They were carrying a sarcophagus? Oh, no! What could they be after?
Find out what the Tep cultists want in the Forbidden Cell.

Above the area where most of the scientists reside, there is another room - the Forbidden Cell. It's protected by a magical shield and none of the institute staff have ever been able to get inside it.
I suspect that it's all related to the peaceful Astral secret project, which Yasker is personally in charge of. The AD Division's best brains are working on it. We began by studying creatures that live in the Astral and near it or, for instance, near Nezebgrad's mana stations. Then we created the experimental amulets and tested them on those dumb capital Orcs... Everything was all going according to plan!
We were inches away from gaining full control over the Astral mutations! Our goal was to find a way to travel freely through the Astral! But then...
Why did the amulets lose their charge now, just as Tep's followers have entered the pyramid? Where is Tep himself? Nothing but questions!
And the answers are right there above our heads. We must get into the Forbidden Cell and get to the bottom of this!
Were you able to get into the Forbidden Cell?
For a long time we could only guess whether Tep was alive or not, but now we have the answer. Do you realize that your victory is the first victory over him for many centuries?
Talk to Sarang Senusret at the ZIT Headquarters.

How do you get into the Forbidden Cell... Wait a second! You said that Tep cultists used a ruin portal? Well, they haven't turned up in the MP Division, the LAD Division, or the AD Division... That must mean there's another portal! And this portal must be inside the Forbidden Cell!
Go to Sarang Senusret quickly! I don't care how he does it, but he must use a ruin portal to send you there! And if he doesn't... Tell him that my next project will be constructing the world's most powerful Sparkton Pack! Custom made, just for him!

A secret portal... Hmm... Well, I did notice a leak in magical energy... Perhaps it will lead us to this very portal.
I can try to send you there, but if something goes wrong, I'm not responsible!
You will need 4 Sparks to use the portal.
Go back to the capital and report to Negus Kheket.

Remember what I was telling you about the peaceful Astral project?
Well, it looks like Tep has been keeping tabs on it all this time... That rock you've found in the sarcophagus is proof positive of that very fact. In it I sense the force of our own spells, the same ones we've used to charge the amulets! And what was the goal? Astral mutations! The dream of making Astral a part of us. But while we were just setting out on this path, Tep seems to have already completed it...
I can't even imagine what he is now. His new body... It must've been him who activated the pyramid, the one and only pyramid that survived the Great Cataclysm! He manipulated the sparks to sow panic amongst our ranks. He activated the ancient portals and set his vile blades at us, while his minions used the chaos to sneak the sarcophagus with the new body into the Pyramid. The body that was most likely subjected to Astral mutations. And now he is reborn! Reborn once more! You must've just missed him... He got what he came there for and is gone. Gone into the Astral, from whence he came.
Don't feel too bad - if you had met him then, you and I wouldn't be having this conversation now.
But hey, there is a bright side to all this! If Tep was successful in his endeavor, then we've got a shot at ours. After all, he used our advances, so that means that we're on the right track!
We must immediately commence the study of that rock! And the sarcophagus! And the Forbidden Cell, now that we have access to it! Oh my, so much to do, so little time!
I beg you, make for the capital and report to Negus Kheket, the Head of the Scientific Council, on everything that has happened! Man, it's too bad Nefer Ur isn't here. He'd get to the bottom of all this in no time!

And I thought that nothing could surprise me... This is huge!
Tep is alive! I've always suspected this, but we finally have proof, irrefutable proof! Not only that, he hasn't lost a beat! Just as he was a millennia ago, his accomplishments in Astral research are miles ahead of our feeble attempts to at least establish control over...
Well, that information is classified.
However, your help has been invaluable and I do want to reward you.
I must also ask you to keep quiet about all this. We cannot disclose information about Tep to my people just like that. If we don't prepare them first, there's no telling what their reaction will be.
Deliver the Interrogation Report to Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad.

Hmm, you know, there really is considerable value to this head!
Pretty interesting... Anyhow, the Interrogation Report is ready for you to deliver to the Head of the City Council in Nezebgrad. What are you looking at me like that for? Curious to see what's inside? Sorry, but that's classified.
Elizaveta Rysina will fill you in, if she deems it necessary. My job is simple - learn what you can and place it on record.

I was already informed of your operation. We have dubbed it codename "Golden Head". How's it coming along?
Give it here. I hope that the Institute will rise to the occasion on this one...

Ship houses... to travel the Astral... Oh, my! Elves from the House de Doucer were able to conduct some bizarre ritual, based on the Astral's magical nature and... Their magic of death. As a result they morphed into... What an odd word... Vampires... Now they can't survive without blood. But when could Elves not survive without it before? They've always thought themselves demigods and other races mere vermin... They always were bloodsuckers to us working people!
Aye... The League and the Empire neck-to-neck... What I wouldn't give to know what they've learned of our advances...
Why is it that secret information is always secret for everyone other than enemy scientists and spies?
You have proven yourself once more! Well done! Please take this reward, you've earned it.
Participate in killing Plamennik and return to Sarang Neithhotep at the OMUT Division.

My dreams have been plagued with my greatest fear, Plamennik. He's a great and terrible fire elemental, designed by Tep himself!
Want to know why we're all afraid of it? It's pure fire! Sizzling and everything! If you fight with him, your body will burn, there'll be nothing but ashes left and then your spark will have nowhere to go...
For us, the Arisen, this is the worst! Die, be resurrected, and then die again - forever this time!
I'm begging you, kill this terrible fire beast! But don't try to be a hero and do it alone! We don't need useless death!
Plamennik will not leave the OMUT Division alone! Why?
Oh thank you, you have saved me from insanity! I have been sitting here all day tending to my singed flesh. A terrible sight, believe me!
Kill 3 Serrated Tep Blades and return to Negus Tot.

It seems that the situation inside the pyramid has been mostly resolved. It's unfortunate that Tep got what he wanted. And now what's left to do? That's right - clean up after him.
We really need to deal with those serrated blades that fly through the pyramid's corridors. Do you think you can clear out a bunch? Just make sure to gather some friends before you fight them. They're one of Tep's most fearsome creations.
Oh, there's so much to be done before things return to normal!
Thanks so much. If you want to help again, feel free to come back tomorrow. There's so much work to do!
Having trouble using the device? It's really quite simple - just find a spark and activate the Sparkton Pack.
Collect 4 clumps of Astral Dust and take them to Simar the Forester.

Do you know anything about the cult of the Twelve Great Martyrs?

Aah! You already have Patronage. Then we can skip the theory.

I'm here to observe the Rite of Light and record everything. You can join me if you like. First you'll need to collect four Astral dust clumps. They settle on creatures who dwell near the Astral. Local elementals, for example. Then take them to the shaman. He'll tell you what to do.
It'd be such a waste if a gust of wind blew once the Astral dust appeared.
Kill the Mysterious Demon Mage and return to Simar the Forester.

For the last part of your initiation, you will kill an Astral demon. Astral demons gather at the platform where you threw the Astral dust into the wind. You must go and kill it to prove to the martyrs your worth.
Go there, kill it, and go to Sarang Ahmes so we can get this over with. Then you will be blessed with the second level of patronage.
What's so hard about killing one demon?

The rite is complete.

Now you can use the Incense I gave you to appeal to your Patron. It will help you in combat.
Speak to Semer Nemar in Yasker's Tower.

I'd like to give you a word of advice. When you arrive in Nezebgrad find Semer Nemar, the Rune Trader, in Yasker's Tower. What are runes? Just listen up.
You can often find runes embedded in different equipment. Runes are magical stones that are ingrained with the power of one of the Great Martyrs. The tradition of embedding runes comes from long ago, when craftsmen knew nothing about the Martyrs and just sensed that the stones have a great magical power.
Now that we know how to use the power, it can be a great advantage on the battlefield. It would be a good idea for you to learn how to use runes. Semer Nemar can help you with that.

Interested in the runes? Good! There's a number of things you can do.
First, you can ask me about the runes.
Second, you can complete a few tasks to find out for yourself how it all works.
Now, your third choice is to admit that you'll always be a loser and go on walking around with your head hung low.
I recommend that you do the first and second things.
Look for Semer Nemar in the Eye of the World and ask him about runes.

So, it's all over. You found your patron, you know what runes are and what power they give you?

Great.

Now I want to give you some advice. Look for the rune merchant Semer Nemar in the Eye of the World when you come to Nezebgrad...

He's the one who will teach you how to work with runes.

Interested in runes?

As you should be. You have several options.

Option one: ask me about the runes.

Option two: complete a few quests and figure it all out by yourself.

Option three: admit that you will always fail and walk away.

I recommend you choose option one and/or two, he-he.
Talk to shaman Simar the Forester, ask him to summon a pet and defeat the powerful goblin in combat.

Soon you will come across runes - magical stones imbued with the powers of the Martyrs. Long time ago people knew nothing about Twelve Great Martyrs, but now the runes are used on purpose. You should learn how to activate runes of your Patron and combine them to greatly increase your powers.
I want you to see for yourself how the runes make you stronger. I'm going to summon my pet for a training fight, you'll fight it without a help of the runes first.
My goblin is not so stupid. Let's see how you manage!

Aha. Goblin is defeated.
Nice victory, ha!
Look at you! A lot of energy was spent, you have been hurt, you need time to recover. This way all the time, yeah?
Ask shaman Simar the Forester to summon the pet and give you the power of runes. Defeat the mighty goblin in combat and return to the shaman.

Ready for another fight? Don't worry, it will be much easier. My spell will make you stronger and give you extra protection, as if you were using runes of the fifth level!
I want you to feel the powers of runes - they all can be yours!
Let me know when you are ready to start.
Only when you have tried the power of runes, you will understand how important it is!

So? Feel the difference?
That's the power of runes! Hope, you'll learn the lesson well.
Now talk to this scientist. Sarang Ahmes. Report him that the ritual is over. And that the runes lesson is learnt by you.
Dig around the ancient Zem artifact and retrieve the treasure.

Hmm, what's this?! There seems to be something lying around here, and it doesn't look like anyone wants it...
Those highbrow scholars must have their heads too far in the clouds to notice it. If you don't take this treasure, it'll just be buried up by the sands and you can't let that happen!
A chest! All that remains is to open it and then the treasures of ancient times will have a new master!
Find the hidden treasure to the north and report your success to Yaver Satiah.

Do the Arisen dream? I can't speak for all of us, but I have pretty vivid ones. In fact, there's one in particular that I keep having that is unbelievably real.
I dream that I'm walking along the sands around the OMUT Division and I see a strange artifact. It's old, and covered with dust and dirt. Then I bend down, dig under it, and pull something out of the sand... Then, as always, I wake up.
I should check one day whether it's just a dream or if there really is some ancient artifact near the OMUT Division, waiting to be discovered... Blast it all, there's so much work to do that I can never find the time.
I keep having that damn dream! I can't wait to have some simple nonsensical ones.
Wow, so it was a vision after all. I wish I could have had time to discover it myself, but this research is more important than treasure hunting. Regardless, I congratulate you on your find!
Decapitate 4 Dead Orcs and bring their heads to Lek the Fierce.

Yeah, I know a thing or two about Skulnar. But he's the last thing on my mind right now. You see, we've had visitors recently - Orcs from the neighboring isles. The bastards pillaged our village and killed Horz.
After we tend to his funeral, we still have to see to avenging his death and electing a new chieftain. Then there are preparations for the Goblinball tournament. Ugh, my head is spinning!
Let's start with the funeral. Horz lived a great life and he died with honor! Before he fell he took plenty of enemies down with him. His late rites need to be done properly, the Orcish way.
We gotta pile the funeral pyre with the heads of his enemies to grant him the revenge he deserves. Their bodies are lying around nearby. Take this axe and decapitate them. But be quick about it, lest the bastards revive. Then you'd need to put them down again!
But what's this? Do I see hesitation in your eyes? You don't want to defile your fellow Imperial citizens, eh? Well, that's just how it is. There's no place for mercy when you're at war. And do you want to know about the descendant of the Legendary Orc or not? If you do, then help us!

Where are the heads? The funeral needs to start soon! Aye, the spirits of perished Orcs may still roam the field of battle.
Just put 'em down and move on!
Ah, the sight of enemy heads brings joy to my heart. I'm sure it makes Horz just as happy! Thank you for helping us give him a traditional funeral.
Collect 4 pieces of Tiger Meat and bring them to Gavelock the Fierce.

Ugh, this is awful!
Because of the attacks and our chieftain's death, all of the Orcs from our clan have been neglecting their duties. They're preparing for war and all that, but soon a trade ship will be here. What will we offer them in exchange for wood, beer, and grub?
They just leave it to old hags like me to think up a solution, I guess. Listen, can you go and bring me a dozen pieces of tiger meat? Those Orcs in Nezebgrad can't get enough of it - it reminds them of home. It's not like that processed stuff that they sell in the capital, it's real wild meat!
The ship is already here! Where's the meat I asked for?

Tiger meat is super nutritious. It makes you strong and is generally good for your health! It's especially beneficial for males, just ask around! Now we'll have plenty of money to buy other stuff. Thanks!
Collect a White Tiger Skin from Sin'ghim and bring it to Vurn the Fierce.

When the Goblinball Tournament was officially announced, I made our clan the most beautiful flag! I put my whole heart into it - each stitch was lovingly sewed. I even pulled some all-nighters to make sure it would be done in time.
But then when those scumbags came and attacked our camp, they tore it to pieces and stomped the shreds into the ground! I damn near cried when I found out! It was one of those worst things they could have done.
Now we need a new flag, and if I hurry I think I can get one made in time. The problem is, I need some new material to make it from. Now I've already got a magnificent idea - there's a white tiger living nearby named Sin'ghim. He's a real beauty, that one! What I need is his hide, and if you can just bring it to me I can get my job underway.
Our clan is the greatest in the Wild Isles and our flag must emphasize that fact!
Just look at this skin! It's so warm, so beautiful. It would make a real fine cape... but the good of the clan is above personal interests! We must prevail!
Defeat the 3 Goblinball Trainees and return to Awl the Fierce.

Seven hells! They've done and killed most of our team! Those despicable cowards! They must have been scared of losing the Goblinball Tournament. And they damn well should be! I'm the best trainer around - I came here from Nezebgrad on the special request of Wrokag himself!
Why? To make real players out of these wild Orcs, that's why! And now all my efforts have gone to waste! Out of our six Orcish team, only two remain.
I've already got my eye on three replacements, but there's barely any time for proper training, what with the Tournament being around the corner!
Help me whip 'em into shape by fighting them, one by one. These boys need to work up their battle spirit! The more pissed off they are, the better they'll play!
I remember the time when Orcs were Orcs, not like today... Don't worry about roughing up the Novices - they can handle it! Bruises only make them tougher.
Heh, something tells me this isn't the last we'll hear of this trio. I think they've got promise. Thanks for your help, I just know we'll still win the Tournament!
Recover 4 Orcish Axes and bring them to Yaver Maiherpri on the Fierce Isle.

I serve the Empire!
I've heard a lot about you. I know you. You're the Imperial Survivor, am I right? Your story is already being told at advanced training courses. Now you're a celebrity of sorts at the Council. Mind helping me with an investigation?
I've been sent here to look into the attack on the Fierce Clan. The circumstances are clear enough - it was yet another bloody altercation between two warring clans. For as long as the local Orcs hold on to their barbaric customs, these kinds of incidents will continue to happen. Still, it's my job to collect evidence, find the guilty parties, and draw up a report. You can help me out with the evidence part - there should still be axes bearing clan emblems lying around the battlefield. Bring me four of these axes.
These Orcs may be Imperial citizens in name, but they have yet to understand the meaning of civility. Do you have the axes I asked for?

Thank you for aiding in the investigation. With the Goblinball Tournament coming up these bloodthirsty Orcs might stop butchering one another for a while.
Goblinball is a barbaric sport, but at least it helps channel their innate violent tendencies in a better direction.
Bring 4 measures of Tiger Blood to Awl the Fierce.

A thousand Astral demons! We're out of blood!
What blood? Tiger blood, obviously! You know what they say about us shamans - that we're not reared on our mother's milk, but on animal blood. The tigers' blood gives us their strength, might, and agility. Every member of my team drinks several pints of it a day. And look what it's done to them - they're invincible!
Hmm... True, most of the tigers have been killed off, but that's no reason to change our age-old traditions! That only means we need to drink as much tiger blood as possible before it's gone! Not to mention I've got a bunch of new players to train and no time to do it.
I need more blood to transform these wimps! Go out and bring me about ten measures of it and I should be good until the Tournament begins.
The players must be mean and fierce! Just like a tiger!

All right! Ahh, tiger blood - fresh, thick, and pure as a tear.
Except... I've been thinking... It's not enough! Can you bring me more? The Orcs will... thank you, yeah!
Reach an agreement with the three competitors for the position of the Fierce Clan's chief.

We've said our goodbyes to Horz, and soon we'll be electing a new chieftain. I say "electing," even though the actual process is nothing like that. Instead, the clan's mightiest Orcs wage battle until only one remains. It is an utterly stupid tradition, because the clan always loses its best fighters as a result.
But this time I want things to be different. I want to be elected without any fighting. And why not? The Orcs are entering a new era, one where they need a spiritual leader that aims for progress. I know I would be the best person for the job. The problem is, not everyone shares my view. For now, that is...
Please speak with the other three contestants and get them to give up their bid for power. Ask them to surrender their weapons and thereby concede my sovereignty over the clan. Help me with this and then I'll help you find Skulnar, but not before.
Did you find all of my competitors? I'm sure we can come to an agreement. There's really no need to shed blood!

They all stepped down? Really? Well, I don't know how you managed to talk them out of it, but I sure am grateful. Please accept this clothing as a token of my gratitude. Now I can tend to the problems of our clan in peace.
Obtain 2 vials of Bloodthirsty Clan Blood and 2 vials of Roughneck Clan Blood and bring them to Awl the Fierce.

I'll start sewing the new banner at once! Then it needs to be painted.
I got this great idea: To paint the banner with the blood of the Orcs that pillaged our village! I'll need five flagons of blood from the Orcs of the Bloodthirsty Clan as well as five flagons from the Orcs of the Roughneck Clan. This is revenge for their attack!
I remember the good old times when our allods were separated by the Astral. Leave it to some egghead in Nezebgrad to think up some damn magical crap that lets us travel between them. Things went downhill then.
But you can't change the past, so the only option is to adapt and show everyone who's boss around here. A banner painted with the murderers' blood is a fine way to do just that.
Bring me the blood of our enemies, and I'll owe you.

Where's the blood I need it!
Hmm, do I seem a bit savage? That's only 'cause I really love our Goblinball team. I'm a die-hard fan!

Hoho! That color will look great against this white fur.
I'll start painting it right away. Ours will be the most beautiful banner at the Goblinball Tournament, you'll see! Here, you can take some of these clothes I made as a reward. Thanks so much!
Collect 4 Orcish Ears from Bloodthirsty Clan Athletes and bring them to Awl the Fierce.

I've come up with a new plan.
At this point anything goes when it comes to those scumbags from the Bloodthirsty and Roughneck Clans. After what they've done, we can do anything we damn well please. Just like in the times of our ancestors, when the world was whole and the Orcs were free to roam the plains and follow their instincts.
Let's deal with the Bloodthirsty Clan first! And by "deal" I mean make sure they won't be showing up to the Tournament. No, we won't behead them like they did to our players. I may be an Orc, but I do know the meaning of mercy!
There is another way - kill them and cut off their ears! Then they'll be resurrected earless! And an earless Orc is the very definition of shame. They will never show their face on the battlefield.
So, are we on the same page? Go cut off the ears of the Bloodthirsty Clan's Goblinball players and bring 'em back to me!

Those Bloodthirsty and Roughneck Clan players are horrible anyway. They ain't got a chance in hell, and that's the bitter truth! The only real challengers are the Orcs from the Fierce and Righteous Clans.
And here are the ears! Now the Bloodthirsty players must wallow in eternal shame. It's a good thing, too - there's no room for barbarians in our great sport!
Obtain the Bloodthirsty Smithing Brand and the Roughneck Smithing Brand and return them to Yaver Maiherpri.

Having studied the evidence, I've come to the conclusion that the attack on Fierce Isle was perpetrated by the Orcs of the Bloodthirsty and the Roughneck clans. The attackers' axes bear their emblems.
However, in order for the evidence to stand up we need to obtain the actual emblems from these clans' blacksmithing brands. Without this ultimate proof my report to the Council will be shot down in flames and widely presented as a model of carelessness and incompetence.
You don't want that, do you? Especially since my report will also be mentioning your valuable aid in the matter. So, what do you say? Can you get me those brands?
The investigation must follow protocol to the letter. Were you able to... to reach an agreement with the blacksmiths?

Let's check these brands against the marks on the axes salvaged from the battlefield... I was right - they're completely identical! The evidence is irrefutable - the attack on the Fierce Clan was carried out by the Bloodthirsty and Roughneck Clans. Thank you for your help!
Kill 4 Orcs from the Bloodthirsty Clan and return to Burdock the Fierce.

So Lek doesn't want to fight, huh? Hmm...
I don't know what to say! To be honest, I would accept him as chieftain if I knew for sure that the Bloodthirsty Clan would pay for our clan members' deaths.
Here's the deal. If you can go over to Bloodthirsty Isle and take out four of those Orcs. Then I will recognize Lek's authority without a fight. I'll even surrender my staff. I'm a reasonable orc!
My heart aches for revenge. And if Lek is not able to see this done, then I'll have no choice but to assume the position of chief!
Finally, those bastards have paid for their deeds! I guess I'm confident enough in Lek to surrender my claim for power. Here, take my staff. Bring it to Lek as a token of my support.
